en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Tunisia–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling where the recipient holds at least 25 per cent of the payer and a 15 per cent ceiling in the other treaty case. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Tunisia–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides source-State exemption where the loan provider is a Contracting State and a 12 per cent ceiling for other interest subject to source-State taxation. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Tunisia–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling for copyright royalties including cinematograph films and television or radio recordings, and a 15 per cent ceiling for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, equipment, know-how, technical or economic studies and technical assistance. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
